title: Revolutionizing oilfield invoicing with automation
outcome: Invoice processing cut from hours to minutes per ticket
challenge: Field ticket invoicing was a manual, hours-per-ticket process that delayed billing and tied up office staff.
whatWeDid: We implemented UiPath RPA to process field tickets and generate invoices automatically, with exceptions routed for review.
results: Processing time cut from hours to minutes per ticket
Office staff freed from manual entry
